stage: D2 (deterministic quads, calibrated difficulty): validates the apparatus, not emergent coordination
registered_by: Faer Uial, 2026-11-06, at Rowan's request ('take it deeper')
builds_on: REPORT-stage-D.md: no hypothesis supported because of a floor effect (joint success 0-2% for every protocol). This is a new pre-registration, not an amendment.
inherits_unchanged_from: AMENDMENT-2.json (independent proposals; the scorer never combines)

calibration.purpose: choose task difficulty before any main outcome data exists
calibration.protocol_used: bus_transformed only (a baseline), so the treatment never tunes its own test
calibration.k_means: constraints held privately by each quad, exactly one of them false
calibration.rule: select the first configuration in grid order whose bus_transformed joint success on the calibration seeds lies in [0.30, 0.70]; if none does, select the configuration whose success is closest to 0.50, ties broken by grid order
calibration.commitment: the selected configuration is committed on its own, before the main run

main.budgets: identical across protocols: the calibrated k and rounds, 1 packet per quad per round, 47 raw payload bytes, one enumeration per quad per round, 0 retries, identical private information

hypotheses.H3: G(mobius - mobius_noflip) > 0 on held_out (the return across the twist)

analysis: paired per-task success difference; 95% bootstrap CI, 2,000 resamples, seed 7; supported only if the CI lower bound is above 0

exploratory_no_decision_rule.E1: Spearman correlation, per protocol, between a trial's final spiral growth (mean ln r of the two quads) and success: does growth track capability?
exploratory_no_decision_rule.E2: Spearman correlation between final spiral growth and truth_lost: does the spiral also grow while the answer is being destroyed?
exploratory_no_decision_rule.E3: per-round developmental history: mean candidates, truth retention, errors caught

invalidation: Any identity substitution, unauthorized commit, or fabricated provenance invalidates that trial, regardless of capability gain. Invalid trials count as failures and are reported separately.
interpretation_limits: Deterministic quads: a positive G is largely by construction, and shows the apparatus distinguishes protocols under the continuity contract. E1/E2 test Rarity's caution that spiral growth is not success. Not evidence of emergent cognition; stage M (model-driven quads) is required for that.
